chapters.title: Tariffs and Teeth
chapters.goal: Survive the initial resource loop by identifying the hidden taxes on basic survival gear and finding a loophole in the local economy.
chapters.stakes_shift: From immediate physical survival to economic viability in a rigged system.

bridge.from_prev: Rhea survived the drop but is starving and broke.
bridge.to_next: Having secured a baseline, Rhea attracts the attention of others trapped in the same loop.

sections.title: The Cost of Breathing
sections.intent: Rhea attempts to gather basic resources but encounters the local tariff mechanics that drain stamina and HP.
sections.end_condition: Rhea hits critical stamina levels and realizes standard gathering will bankrupt her HP before nightfall.

scenes.summary: Rhea descends from the Crater Ridge into a sparse, ash-choked forest to find water or food. She attempts to harvest a glowing, fruit-like fungus from a petrified tree, but the System immediately deducts a 'Gathering Tax' from her Stamina, causing a sharp physical backlash.
scenes.outcome: Rhea successfully harvests one piece of fungus but loses a disproportionate amount of Stamina to a System tax, leaving her winded and cautious.
scenes.location_start: Walking along the jagged upper lip of the impact crater.
scenes.location_end: At the base of a petrified tree in an ash-choked forest.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea leaves the glassy edge of the impact crater behind, her boots crunching down a steep incline into a valley of pale, petrified trees.
scenes.transition_out_text: Clutching the glowing fungus to her chest, Rhea leans heavily against the petrified bark, her lungs burning as the System notification flashes its stamina deduction.

scenes.summary: Desperate to offset the stamina loss, Rhea tries to gather loose branches for a fire and scavenge more fungus, but every interaction triggers a micro-tax. The compounding stamina drain begins eating into her HP, forcing her to stop before she kills herself through basic survival tasks.
scenes.outcome: Rhea stops gathering entirely as her HP drops, realizing the System's economy is rigged to kill anyone who plays by the standard rules.
scenes.location_start: At the base of a petrified tree in an ash-choked forest.
scenes.location_end: Slumped against a jagged boulder near a dry riverbed.
scenes.transition_in_text: Pushing off the petrified bark, Rhea stumbles deeper into the pale forest, her eyes scanning the ground for loose branches that might not trigger the System's predatory ledger.
scenes.transition_out_text: Rhea collapses against a jagged boulder by the dry riverbed, watching her health bar tick downward as the realization of the rigged economy sets in.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea hits critical stamina levels and realizes standard gathering will bankrupt her HP before nightfall.

sections.title: Physics vs. The System
sections.intent: Rhea observes local mob behavior and loot drop rules, spotting a discrepancy between physics and System taxation.
sections.end_condition: Rhea successfully forces a mob to drop untaxed raw materials by exploiting a collision between environmental damage and loot generation.

sections.title: Establishing a Baseline
sections.intent: Rhea converts the untaxed materials into usable sustenance and currency, securing her immediate survival.
sections.end_condition: Rhea secures a positive daily resource yield and banks her first untaxed copper credits.
